meta.title: Soscitea — Montreal Social Science Events
meta.description: Soscitea — Montreal social science events, seminars, and talks in one place.

hero.deck: As technology mediates more of what we read, share, and debate, the humanities and social sciences need a clearer, more visible place in public life. Soscitea gathers lectures, colloquia, and cultural events where critical thought still happens, and makes them easy to discover.

events.emptyHint: Try clearing the search or choosing a different discipline.

footer.text: Soscitea aggregates Montreal social-science events from universities, research centres, and student associations — refreshed nightly from sources across the city.
